balls.text: zing bails go flying, and DC have been rolled over for 75! Hazlewood has four, and he fittingly lands the final blow. Searing yorker on middle and leg. Porel looks to jam it out into the off side but is too late on it. Ball sneaks past his blade and crashes into the furniture. Third lowest-score in the IPL for the Delhi-based franchise, and RCB have run rampant across an hour and a half in the capital!
that is some shot! Hard length just outside off. Porel stands up tall, opens up his stance and swats it over the bowler's head!
length ball outside off. Porel throws his hands at it and edges it down to deep third. Single not taken, rightly
googly on a back of a length on off. Chameera goes right back and pats it gently into the on side
back of a length outside off and this goes straight through. Chameera thinks about playing at it before tucking his bat inside the line
wrong'un on a length on off. Chameera lunges forward and prods it into the on side

hot knife through butter, and DC are nine down now! Leg-spinner on a back of a length outside off. Kuldeep does not pick it off the hand and tries to play it off the pitch. The ball, though, has lots of fizz on it and bursts through his attempted flick. Stumps rattled, and Suyash is finally on the board!
googly on a length outside off. Kuldeep gets onto the front foot and defends
tossed up full and wide. Kuldeep throws his hands at it and slices it towards backward point
slower and fuller outside off. Kuldeep opens his bat face and guides it towards short third
back of a length outside off. Porel opens his bat face and runs it down to short third
wow - what was that?! Speared across the batter a mile outside off, which is a response to Porel advancing. He nearly ends up on the deck trying to keep it out. Patted into the off side
flighted up outside off. Kuldeep yorks himself by advancing and digs it out behind point for a single
fired in full on middle and off. Porel skips down and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
the seam-up bumper is out now. Short and wide, and Porel dabs it to short third
back of a length on leg and Kuldeep is rushed again. Plays all over it and gets pinged on the pad. Going down leg, though. Would have probably pitched outside leg too
oh dear! Darted in a mile down leg, perhaps as a riposte to Kuldeep shaping for the reverse. He abandons that thought mid-way and gets the wide. Good take by Jitesh
nicely bowled. Googly tossed up full on middle and off. Draws Kuldeep forward and then beats him on the outside with a ripper
back of a length outside off. Zips through and spins in a touch. Kuldeep drops it towards slip with soft hands
googly on a back of a length on leg. Kuldeep goes right back and defends
short and down leg. Kuldeep does not get bat on it, and that is an easy decision for the umpire
well well! Googly hung up on a length outside off. Kuldeep, rather ambitiously, looks for the reverse and misses
googly on a length on leg. Porel skips down the track and pushes it into the wide mid on region
shortish outside off. Porel hops back and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length on middle and leg, and this skids through. Porel, cramped for room, stabs it back to the bowler
very slow on a length on leg. Kuldeep waits an eternity for the ball to arrive before dinking it into the square leg region

pinned on the back leg, and the finger goes up! Jamieson is not inclined to review initially but then opts for it reluctantly! Back of a length on middle, and this straightens after pitching. Jamieson plays for the angle and plays all around it. Seemed pretty straight but was it bouncing over? Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking comes up and...it shows the ball to be clipping the top of middle. Umpire's Call, and Jamieson has to go!
back of a length on off. Porel hangs back and knocks it to long on
shortish outside off. Porel hops back and cuts it through point. Shepherd does enough to stop the boundary but cannot prevent a brace
leg-spinner on a length on off. Jamieson opts to hang back before prodding it towards mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Played back to the bowler off the back foot
length ball just outside off. Jamieson goes back and pokes it towards extra cover
googly on a back of a length outside off. Spins in and Jamieson is nearly done in. Stabs at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
leg-spinner on a back of a length outside off. Jamieson looks for the cut but is beaten for pace
speared in on a length down leg. Jamieson does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
googly on a full length on the pads. Jamieson plonks it on the bounce to square leg
back of a length outside off. Jamieson hangs back and pats it towards extra cover
shortish outside off. Jamieson gets up on his toes again and jabs it towards extra cover
what timing! Back of a length on middle and off. Jamieson rises with the bounce and pings it right off the middle of the bat over mid wicket!
length outside off. Jamieson comes forward and drives it on the up towards mid off
right out of the screws, and DC have gone past 50! They have gone past 49, more precisely. Banged in short outside off. Jamieson uses his long frame and thumps it over deep square leg!
length ball on the pads. Porel tucks it towards deep square leg
shortish on middle and leg. Porel rocks back and punches it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
googly on a back of a length outside off. Porel shapes for the cut but is beaten by the skid off the surface
googly to welcome Jamieson. He reads it off the pitch and works it behind square to get off the mark
googly flighted up full outside off. Porel stretches forward and pushes it to long off
googly hung up full outside off. Porel pushes it to extra cover and sets off, only to be sent back by Jamieson

peach to begin, and Jitesh might have put this down! Googly on a length on leg and this snakes away a mile. Porel does not pick it and then plays down the wrong line. Beaten all ends up. Not sure if there was bat involved. UltraEdge confirms no outside edge

a massive shank, and Miller has to go too! DC seven down! Pace-on now and this is a touch shorter just outside off. Miller has a massive mow across the line and gets it all wrong. The ball pops up off the toe-end and Jitesh does the rest. Miller throws the bat away in disgust, and this partnership has been broken. RCB with another body blow before the time-out!
easy as you like! Another slower ball but in the slot on middle and off. Miller plants his front foot and lifts it over the bowler's head!
off-pace again, on a fullish length on middle and leg. Miller spots it in time and pushes it towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Miller presses half forward and prods it towards mid wicket
shot! Another half-tracker outside off and Miller takes full toll. He stands up on his toes and thunders it to deep mid wicket's left!
slower ball on a fullish length on middle and leg. Porel comes forward and chips it towards long on
length ball, honing into off. Miller lets the ball come to him before offering the full face of the bat
back of a length on middle and off. Porel gets behind the line of the ball and knocks it to long on
shortish again, and this sits up just outside off. Porel hoicks it on the bounce to deep backward square leg and hustles back for a brace
hard length on middle and leg. Miller pokes it to deep mid wicket, and brings up 12000 runs in T20 cricket. Quinton de Kock and Faf du Plessis are the two other South Africans to get to that mark!
another half-tracker on middle and off. Porel picks it up and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
the runs are flowing now, eh?! Short and sliding into the hips. Porel swivels nicely and helps it behind square into the long leg fence!
hard length, angling into off. Porel stays back and stabs it out towards deep mid wicket. 12 off the over, and DC have nearly doubled their total in one over...
back of a length on middle and off. Keeps a little low and Miller eases it out to deep mid wicket
Miller stamps his authority too! Full outside off. Miller gets a good stride in, shows the maker's name and threads it between mid off and extra cover!
hard length just outside off. Porel has a stab at it and chunks it off the inside edge into the on side
first shot of authority all evening! Marginally dragged down on middle and off. Porel picks up the length early and hammers it over mid wicket!
full and slanting into the pads. Miller flicks it powerfully towards deep mid wicket but has to settle for just a single
back of a length just outside off. Porel gets a half stride in before jabbing it back to the bowler
another ripper! Banged in short on off, and this nips in, while also rearing up. Porel does well to keep his eyes on the ball and sways out of the way
back of a length just outside off. Porel hangs back, opens hia bat face and taps it towards backward point
back of a length outside off and this skips through. Porel looks for the cut and throws his hands at it, but it is beaten for pace
shortish on middle and off. Miller hops up onto his toes and turns it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on off. Porel gets up on his toes and runs it down to deep backward point
fullish on middle and off, and this straightens against the angle. Miller wants to work to leg and the ball plinks off the leading edge into the off side
back of a length, slanting into middle and leg from around the wicket. Miller tucks it into the square leg region, and Porel has to scramble back on the second. DC into double digits now!
back of a length, zoning into off stump again. Miller watches the ball like a hawk and meets it right under his eyes
back of a length on leg. Miller lets the ball come to him before stabbing it into the on side
angled in on a length on off. Miller gets a half stride in and blocks
edged but it falls short! Full just outside off and this moves away late. Miller goes fishing at it and gets a thick outside edge that bounces just in front of slip
shortish outside off. Miller rises with the bounce and drops it behind point to open his account

an absolute snorter, and Rana has to trudge off for an early shower too! Back of a length on off and this nips back in, while also rearing up. Rana does not know where to go and he hangs up his bat like a periscope. Takes his eyes off the ball too, and it pops up off the glove. Padikkal moves to his left, takes the catch, and piles further misery on the Capitals!
pushed in on a length outside off. Rana presses forward before watching it go through to the keeper
fullish on middle and leg. Rana comes onto the front foot and plays it back to the bowler
fuller outside off. Rana comes forward and laces his square drive but he cannot get it past a diving Krunal at cover point. Superb work to his left
back of a length just outside off. Skips through and Rana is content to let it go
superb in-swinging yorker on middle and leg. Porel gets his bat down in time and clinks it out to mid on
full and spearing down leg. First time tonight RCB have not been able to control the swing but Jitesh bails them out with a sprawling dive to his right
length outside off. Porel gets a half stride in and punches it on the up towards gully

no need for DRS this time, and DC are being ripped to absolute shreds here! Back of a length in the channel just outside off. Angles in and then snakes away. Axar is all at sea and he prods at it in hope. The ball skims the bottom edge and Jitesh lunges forward to send the DC skipper on his way. DC are five down for seven runs and no - this is not a drill!

oh, how has that missed off stump?! This is a searing in-swinger, pitching very full just outside off. Axar plays inside the line and seems to nick the ground with his blade. Bhuvneshwar is very interested in the caught-behind, and RCB go upstairs. Clear gap between bat and ball, though, and RCB lose a review. First thing they have gotten wrong so far this evening. But hang on. Replays show that the ball actually scraped the stump. Murmur on UltraEdge too, and that is what caused the noise!
length ball outside off and this shapes away nicley. Axar comes forward and shoulders arms

another edge, and another wicket! Bhuvneshwar has the ball on a string, and DC are in freefall! Length ball outside off and this leaves the batter very, very late. Stubbs goes feeling for it without any footwork and the ball kisses the outside edge. Padikkal gobbles it up at wide slip, and DC are four down inside three overs!
peach! This is proper Test match bowling. On a length in the channel and seaming away a smidgen. Rana nibbles at it with minimal footwork and gets beaten
back of a length just outside off. Rana hangs back and the ball rushes to ping the toe-end. Bobbles down to wide slip
fuller and wider outside off. Stubbs gets a good stride in and drives it enough to mid off's left for a single
off the mark in style! Some response to the hat-trick ball. Full and slanting into middle and leg. Stubbs rolls his wrists over it and clips it between mid on and mid wicket!

nicked and gone! Hazlewood has two in two, and DC have lost three across eight balls! This is a proper tempter. Full, wide and inviting the drive. Rizvi, though, does not show the necessary conviction. A bit of a loose waft and the ball grazes the outside edge on its way through to the keeper. Hazlewood on a hat-trick, and DC in all sorts!

goes straight up, and Rahul is outta here too! Banged in short just outside off and this climbs through at 141.4kph. Rahul looks for the pull but the ball is onto him much, much quicker than he expects. Plinks off the splice and Jitesh calls early to complete the catch. RCB over the moon; DC, still trying to figure out what has hit them!
on a length outside off and this shapes away late from around the wicket. Rana happy to let it go
another in-swinger, on a back of a length and finishing on middle and leg. Rahul helps it down to fine leg and opens his account
back of a length, pitching in the channel and nipping in. Rahul gets behind the line of the ball and defends
full outside off, shaping back in again. Rana tips it to mid off and a slight fumble makes the single a comfortable exercise

middle stump out of the ground, and Bhuvneshwar has cleaned up the debutant with a corker! Very full and this starts on middle stump before swerving back in devilishly. Parakh has no clue about it (and he is not the first to meet this fate either), and he cannot jam his bat down in time. Bat hits the ground, ball sneaks past the blade and middle stump is left in a mess. RCB on the board very early!
back of a length in the channel, shaping in slightly. Parakh has a jab at it and edges it down to short third

the demolition job is complete, and Kohli wraps up a rout in thunderous style! Half-tracker and this sits up outside off. Kohli spots it early, gets into position and wallops it over deep mid wicket. Hugs and handshakes in the RCB camp. They have been full value for this win. The Capitals, a little more downcast because they now they have been blitzed out of the water tonight!
Kohli goes bang! Back of a length outside off. Kohli plants his front foot, fetches it from outside the line and smokes it flat over the bowler's head!
back of a length just outside off. Kohli rises with the bounce and plays it back to the bowler
flighted up full outside off. Kohli comes onto the front foot and pushes it to long off to bring up 9000 runs in the IPL!
slowed up on a fullish length outside leg. Padikkal shapes for the sweep and seems to glove it just over the keeper's head. Gets a single for his troubles
pushed in on a length on middle and leg. Kohli tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
Axar tries the bouncer now, on middle and leg. Padikkal hacks it to deep mid wicket

a direct hit, and Padikkal was gone! Back of a length on middle and leg. Kohli cuts it off the stumps and calls for the single. Rahul lets the throw go, thinking it will hit the stumps and that allows Padikkal, sprawling anyway, to make it!
fired in on a length on middle and off. Kohli comes forward and blocks
shot of the night perhaps! Angled into the slot on middle and leg. Padikkal gives himself a hint of room and crunches it over mid off!
banged in short on off. Padikkal steps down the track before flat-batting it straight to mid off
makes no difference! Seems like a slower short ball. Sits up on middle and off and Padikkal, swiveling inside the line, boshes it fine of deep backward square leg!
the runs continue to flow! Shortish just outside off. Padikkal opens up his stance and belts a pull between mid on and mid wicket!
Padikkal is in a hurry! Length ball on the pads and this is in the left-hander's arc. He snaps his wrists into action and whips it over the deep backward square leg fence!
back of a length outside off. Kohli wafts at it and gets a thick outside edge that bobbles in front of Kuldeep at short third. A fumble allows a single
leg-cutter on a back of a length outside off. Jabbed out towards extra cover
four more! Dug in short on leg. Padikkal jumps up onto his toes, gets inside the line and pulls it into the fine leg fence. Nice roll of the wrists too, and that sped away!
low full toss on the stumps but Kohli cannot put it away. Uses the angle and glances it towards long leg
off-pace on a back of a length on leg. Padikkal backs away and dabs it towards backward point, who slides over it and ends up conceding a run
uff, this is a terrific shot! Back of a length on middle and off. Padikkal dances down the track and creams it on the up over mid off!
hard length on middle and off. Padikkal hangs back and prods it into the point region
back of a length in the channel. Padikkal gets squared up and prods at it. The outside edge bounces in front of slip, who misfields and parries it to deep third

in the air, and taken superbly by Natarajan! Back of a length outside off. Bethell hares down the track and swipes at it. Clinks it off the toe-end and the ball goes straight up. Natarajan runs back from mid on, takes it over his shoulder and then shows nifty footwork to tiptoe around the rope without stepping onto the cushion. Brilliant work by the pacer, and Bethell has to go!
back of a length on middle. Bethell wants to drop and run into the off side but Kohli says no
this is even bigger! Banged into the track on middle and leg. Bethell walks down the track and clatters it a mile over mid wicket. A 104m six!
picked up and deposited! Marginally short on leg. Bethell spots the length early, opens up his front hip and whacks it over mid wicket!
zipped in full outside off. Kohli tries to hit it too hard and shanks it to mid on. Scurries across for another quick single
back of a length outside off. Kohli punches it towards extra cover, who fumbles and allows Kohli to scamper across and keep strike
leg-cutter on a back of a length outside off. Kohli waits on it before dabbing it towards point
short and wide outside off. Kohli gets up on his toes and slaps it towards mid off
off the mark in pristine fashion! Slot ball outside off. Kohli plants his front foot, goes through the line and pumps it over the bowler's head!
back of a length outside off. Kohli tries to force it through the off side and scuffs it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Bethell skips down and tries to crash this over mid off. Chunks it off the inside edge into his body and has to settle for a single
full just outside off, swinging in a touch. Bethell drills it back to the bowler, who half-stops it and ends up conceding a single
sliced but safe! Length ball hung up wide outside off. Bethell throws the lot at it and gets just enough on it to clear cover. Back for a brace
length ball on middle, shaping back in. Bethell advances, trying to go downtown but only jams it off the inside edge into his back thigh
back of a length just outside off. Bethell rises with the bounce and defends into the off side
back of a length on middle and leg. Bethell gets up on his toes and taps it into the on side
RCB up and running! Length ball that starts on leg and shapes further down. Bethell helps it fine past the keeper, but that may have come off the thigh pad. Given as runs for now!
